scenes.headline: What a 2B student learns from a 2.4T teacher
scenes.sub: Qwen3.8-2B-Distill, read from its GGUF headers, training file and eval YAMLs.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Coconut! Qwen3.8-2B-Distill is pitched as a giant teacher's reasoning in a two-billion-parameter model for phones. Here's what's actually inside.

scenes.text: The distillation is a short style transfer: about 30,000 teacher traces teach a 2B model to state its answer and stop.

scenes.title: The training run, from its own file

items.say: The Qwen3.8 teacher writes about thirty thousand reasoning traces.
They're packed into fixed-length bins, with the loss on the prompts too.
One epoch, every parameter, on a single GPU: about a hundred optimizer steps.
Then it's converted for llama.cpp. The smallest file is one point three one two gigabytes.

scenes.title: Where the bytes and the memory go

steps.say: A token climbs twenty-four layers. Eighteen are Gated DeltaNet, with a fixed state that never grows. Six are full attention.
steps.note: interleaved: three DeltaNet, then one attention, six times

steps.say: The embedding table doubles as the output layer, so llama.cpp keeps it at six bits: a third of the download.
Only the six attention layers cache keys and values. At the full advertised context, that's three point two two gigabytes, more than the weights.

scenes.title: Where the GSM8K gain comes from
scenes.text: flexible gain = strict gain + gap closed
scenes.say: Now the headline: GSM8K from thirty-three to sixty-four percent, scored on the last number the model writes.

parts.note: +0.095 when the answer must follow 'The answer is'
parts.say: Under strict matching, the base already scores fifty-four point five, so the gain there is nine point five points.

parts.note: +0.215: the student stops talking after its answer
parts.say: The rest is the student learning to stop after its answer. That closing gap is sixty-nine percent of the headline.

scenes.text: This distillation mostly taught output discipline: answer, then stop. That's worth having, and it isn't the same as reasoning.

recap: About 30,000 traces, one epoch, one GPU
Hybrid layers keep the KV cache survivable
69% of the GSM8K gain is extraction
scenes.say: To recap: a cheap full fine-tune, a hybrid stack that makes long context possible, and a gain that's mostly learning to stop.
